narrationTexts: I'll start by looking at the project.
finalText:
**Build passes now, exit 0.** Two real bugs, not noise.

The bump renamed `retries` to `retryCount`, so `resolveRetries` crashed on `undefined`. Fixed in [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6). The new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined`, which `isBackoffEnabled` threw on. Unset now means off, in [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7).

The other 8 lines are real deprecation warnings. `Buffer()`, `fs.exists`, `punycode`, `crypto.createCipher` and 4 more.

Next: clear those deprecations if you want a truly silent log.
